summary: Full browser test of /app/kali (Kali terminal overhaul) as student. Things that work: page render, lab group order, the sandbox interpreter, vi, msfconsole, auto-checks for lx-users id/groups, hint/solution/ladder buttons, persistence across reload (when you wait for the load to finish), reset, sh-intro read -p prompt, and ping-sweep starter. 4 bugs found: (1) a race condition in KaliWorkbench.load sends lab progress to the wrong state (seen in the DB), (2) nano opens with a stray leading newline, (3) the lx-users 'Delete the user' task completes before the user exists, (4) lab list counters show 0/N after reload until you open the lab.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: load() has no stale/cancel guard. If the learner clicks a lab before the earlier GET /kali/state/sandbox returns (e.g. right after page load), the late sandbox response overwrites state. The task panel then shows lx-users tasks (lab comes from `cur`) but the terminal runs the sandbox fs. The lab's checks run against it and done ids are PUT to the SANDBOX doc. Reproduced: after reload I clicked lx-users at once, the panel showed 0/6, my lab file was 'missing', and Mongo kali_state sandbox doc got done:['5']. Fix: track the latest key in a ref (or AbortController) and ignore responses whose key !== the current key; also derive the lab from state.key, not cur.

`nano <newfile>` opens with text '\n'. The Enter keystroke from the terminal input leaks into the newly focused textarea (NANO mode accepts onChange; vi NORMAL mode ignores it, so vi is not affected). Every nano-saved file starts with a blank line ('cat note.txt' shows an empty first line, and head -n1 | wc -c = 1). This can break shebangs (#!/bin/bash on line 2) and line-based checks. Fix: open the editor after a tick, or call preventDefault on the Enter keydown in Terminal.onKey before exec.

The check passes vacuously because analyst2 does not exist at the start. It completes on the very first command (the toast 'Task 6 complete: Delete the user' fires after `id`). It completes again after Reset on any command. Fix: require /userdel/ in last.cmd, or require task 3 to be done first.

doneMap is filled only when a lab is opened, so after a page reload every lab shows 0/N even when progress is saved (lx-users saved 3/6 but the list showed 0/6 until clicked). Fix: add a batch GET of all done counts (e.g. GET /api/kali/state) on mount.
Title always reads 'kali@lab-phish-ransom — bash' (it uses the baseLab id) instead of 'sandbox' or the current lab id.

integration_issues.issue: reset() does not clearTimeout(saveT). If the learner runs a command and clicks Reset within 600 ms, the debounced PUT fires after the DELETE and brings the old state back. (Found in code review; not reproduced.)

verified_working: Header 'Analyst workstation', lab list, terminal and right panel render
Group order: Free-play sandbox, LINUX ESSENTIALS, SHELL SCRIPTING, PENTEST AUTOMATION (KaliLabs.jsx line 10 was already in this order)
echo hi | tr a-z A-Z -> HI; for loop 1 2 3; $((x*2)) -> 10; redirect + cat
vi hello.sh: i, type, Esc, :wq; cat shows 'echo hello'; bash hello.sh -> hello
nano opens, ^O/^X save and exit (apart from the leading newline bug)
msfconsole search vsftpd / use 0 / set RHOSTS / run -> meterpreter; exit, exit -> back to bash
lx-users: id -> task0 green + toast; groups -> task1; kali-task-count and the list counter update
Persistence across reload (when load is not raced); Reset clears done and files; the ladder resets to 'Show hint'
sh-intro: echo Hello SOC + read -p prompt work (2/6)
auto-ping-sweep: starter script shown, 3 ladder steps reveal, then the button is disabled
No page errors; only expected 401s from auth/me before login
action_items: Add a stale-response guard in KaliWorkbench.load and derive `lab` from state.key
Stop the Enter keystroke leaking into the nano textarea (leading newline)
Make the lx-users 'Delete the user' check require a userdel command or task 3 done first
Load all lab done counts on mount so the list counters are correct after reload
clearTimeout(saveT.current) in reset() and when switching labs
Optional: show the current lab id in the terminal title
critical_code_review_comments: KaliPage returns null forever if GET /labs/lab-phish-ransom fails. Add an error state.
load() swallows GET errors as {} and seeds a fresh fs. A later PUT can then overwrite real saved progress after a temporary network error.
